summary: Replaced the process-wide settings with a frozen Settings value, settings.make() and an explicit conf first parameter throughout quoter. The cache is keyed by settings and the old import-time reads are now per-call. Tests are ported to the new API and pass (70 tests). I also compared CLI output with the original package on about 450 random runs, with no differences, and checked library calls under several settings in one process against the original CLI.
